'''Clarisse''' is an NPC located in {{Location|City Square|nocat=1}} at night (6:00 PM - 5:59 AM) and can be found near Ragunna City's [[Resonance Nexus]] painting a [[Jester]] [[Common Echoes|Common Echo]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Clarisse:''' Hello, how can I help you?
:{{DIcon}} Are you painting?
:'''Clarisse:''' I sometimes sketch in the Order. But I'd also love to capture the lively streets of Ragunna aside from the churches.
:'''Clarisse:''' Oh, pardon me. I hope I'm not causing you any trouble, sketching here... Am I blocking your view?
:{{DIcon}} A person painting the scenery can become part of it too.
:'''Clarisse:''' What? What do you mean?
:{{DIcon}} (Tell her about Davide)
::'''Clarisse:''' Mr. Davide? Hmm... it's the first time I've heard that name.
::'''Clarisse:''' Did he want to buy this drawing? But I'm just an amateur trying to pursue my hobby...
::'''Clarisse:''' I see. I'll go find him in Montelli Quarter if I get the chance. Thank you.
:{{DIcon}} (Not tell her about Davide)
:'''Clarisse:''' Goodbye, and may Imperator bless you.
{{Dialogue End}}
